current_grouping: Subpart G — Operating Limitations And Information

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations And Information
versions.text:
(a) Each operating limitation specified in CS 23.1505 to 23.1527 and other limitations and information necessary for safe operation must be established.
(b) The operating limitations and other information necessary for safe operation must be made available to the crew members as prescribed in CS 23.1541 to 23.1589.
